quotes: The CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 data sets consists of 50,000 training and 10,000 test images each.
contradictions.description: Table 1 lists 60,000 training images for CIFAR-10/100, whereas Appendix B.3 specifies 50,000 training images for each data set.

quotes: The best performing convolutional nets that do not use dropout achieve an error rate of 3.95%.
Conv Net + stochastic pooling (Zeiler and Fergus, 2013)                    2.80
contradictions.description: The text identifies 3.95% as the best error rate without dropout, but the accompanying table reports a lower 2.80% error for convolutional nets using stochastic pooling, listed separately from the dropout models.

quotes: Similarly, for an 8-layer net the error reduces from 20.5% to 19.7%.
contradictions.description: The narrative gives the eight-layer network's baseline error as 20.5%, while Table 7 reports 20.7%. The table assigns 20.5% to a different, five-layer mcRBM-DBN model.
